chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

Ali (peace be upon him) passed by a group of people eating locusts, so he said: 'Glory be to Allah, and you are in Ihram?' They said: 'It is from the game of the sea.' So he said to them: 'Throw it into the water then.'

key_terms.مُحْرِمُونَ: In the state of Ihram (ritual consecration)

ai.seo_question: Are locusts permissible to eat while in the state of Ihram?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) narrates that Ali (peace be upon him) observed companions eating locusts during Ihram; when they justified their consumption by classifying locusts as 'sea prey' (due to their aquatic larval stage), Ali (peace be upon him) commanded them to discard them, highlighting the scholarly debate on whether locusts are exempt from the general prohibition of land game for those in Ihram. This incident underscores the precision required in distinguishing between permissible and prohibited sustenance during the sacred state, reflecting the Imams' attention to both literal and biological classifications in fiqh.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Aliasws passed by a group of people eating locusts. So heasws said: ‘Glory be to Allahazwj, and you are in Ihraam?’ So they said, ‘But rather, it is from the hunted preys of the sea’. So heasws said to them: ‘Thrown it into the water then’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that once

Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, passed by a people who were eating locusts. He said Tasbih (Allah is free of all defects) and you are in the state of Ihram! They said, ‘It is of the object of hunting from the sea.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘If that is the case, then throw them in the sea.’”
